summary: A public explanation page that says how the app uses AI, what the AI characters are, how claims are checked, and how to report an error.
purpose: Gives fans a plain account of where AI is used and where it is not, so they can trust the numbers.
why: Likely reason: the app makes promises about AI that fans should be able to read and check.
